business_problem: Wayfair needed to reduce developer context switching and long CI failure recovery times by giving engineers fast, contextual explanations and fixes inside the tools they already use.
solution_summary: Wayfair built a CI/CD intelligence system on Google Cloud that combines Gemini, retrieval-augmented generation, and secure developer-tool integrations. When a post-commit build fails, a custom RAG pipeline analyzes Buildkite logs and historical resolution data, then uses Gemini to produce explanations and suggested fixes delivered directly in Slack. Through an MCP Server integration, the same guidance can also be accessed inside developer tools such as Cursor, so engineers no longer have to jump across dashboards and log systems to diagnose failures. Gemini platform integration and prompt tuning helped the system become accurate enough for daily engineering use, while the architecture spans infrastructure, developer tooling, ML, and security teams. The result is a workflow where CI failures become searchable, explainable events and developers can recover from broken builds much faster with far less manual context gathering.
